name: It's All Fun and Games Until...

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Darnassus respond at once to a discovery marked by ancient corruption.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can bring troubling discoveries to night elf authorities so Darnassian scholars can examine and contain dangerous relics.

aliases: who gives its all fun and games until
who turns in its all fun and games until
faq.answer: Thundris hears the adventurer's troubling report and examines the item or evidence presented. He prepares it for transport.
faq.q: Who is involved in completing this quest?

faq.answer: Thundris sees the mark of an ancient evil and says the finding will be taken to Darnassus at once for study.
faq.q: Why is the object being sent to Darnassus?

faq.answer: Thundris names the mark of an ancient evil, but gives no details about its origins before closer study in the night elven capital.
faq.q: What is the ancient evil referenced by Thundris?

faq.answer: “Ande'thoras-ethil” is a Darnassian phrase Thundris speaks as he finishes talking with you, after saying the find will be taken to Darnassus.

aliases: what happens after its all fun and games until
next quest after fun and games
faq.answer: After recognizing the mark of ancient corruption, Thundris prepares the relic for immediate transport to Darnassus, where scholars can examine it.
faq.q: What happens after completing the quest?

aliases: is its all fun and games alliance only
who can do its all fun and games until
faq.answer: Darnassian leadership and night elf figures like Thundris handle the matter, bringing threats before the night elven authorities.

sections.body: You bring a troubling discovery to Thundris and seek his counsel. He listens to your report and examines what you have brought. Then he falls quiet, for the signs before him are too dark to dismiss.
sections.title: A Troubling Report

sections.body: Thundris sees the mark of an ancient evil on the discovery. He knows the danger reaches beyond a local mishap, so he sends the relic at once to Darnassus. The capital's scholars and priests will study it and keep it contained.
sections.title: The Mark of Ancient Evil

summary: Thundris hears a troubled report and examines the discovery brought before him. Its mark sends the relic to Darnassus for study.
attribution: In-game quest text: It's All Fun and Games Until...
